name: Mood Journal
short_description: Reflect and journal with the storage you have
long_description: User-led journaling, brief mood updates, future inquiry topics, and clinician summaries. Uses native project context, single-file memory, local projects, or authorized storage tools. Clearly distinguishes verified records, summary memory, retained chat entries, and pending saves.
starter_prompts: Prepare a summary for my next appointment.
